spring.registry.etcd.description: One named block per etcd cluster. Each block becomes ONE backend bean named 'etcd.<name>' implementing both discovery.Registrar (write) and discovery.Discovery (read). No default/unnamed block.

spring.registry.service-name.description: Registration intent signal: logical service name to advertise into every configured center. Unset means pure consumer (registers nothing).

spring.registry.addr.description: Advertised host:port of this instance (required when service-name is set)

spring.registry.id.description: Instance id override; empty derives from service-name+addr

spring.registry.weight.description: Initial load-balancing weight shared by every center

spring.registry.metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value attributes stored with the instance

ttl.description: Lease duration; rounded up to whole seconds
